title: Unit Testing
definition: Unit testing involves testing individual, isolated pieces of code (like a single middleware function or a utility math function). You mock out the `req` and `res` objects to ensure the function behaves correctly without needing to spin up the actual Express server.

answers.answer: Unit testing involves testing individual, isolated pieces of code (like a single middleware function or a utility math function).

answers.question: When should you avoid using Unit Testing?
answers.answer: It depends on the specific architectural requirements and performance bottlenecks of your application. Overusing it can sometimes lead to tightly coupled code.
